title: Greenland shark: range, metabolism and population growth (data and code)
description: Minimal data and R code to reproduce the three-panel Greenland shark (Somniosus microcephalus) figure in Dulvy & VanderWright (2027), Quick Guide: Greenland shark, Current Biology: (A) the distribution of the sleeper sharks, (B) the temperature dependence of shark resting metabolic rate, and (C) the maximum intrinsic rate of population increase across sharks. Code is MIT-licensed; data in data/ and outputs/ are CC BY 4.0. IUCN Red List range polygons are not included.
